name: folder
description: A horizontal rounded folder with a distinct tab and a straight movable front-panel edge.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner-approved horizontal Folder. Single rounded outer contour with a straight front-panel edge at y=10.9. Bounds x=3..21, y=4.3..19.7; default stroke is 1.7, with visible left/right padding 2.15 and top/bottom 3.45. The approved X=100%, Y=110% geometry is baked into the path coordinates, preserving constant stroke width and the existing part names.

review.note: Owner approved both styles. Y scaling and constant stroke/gap have been baked into the source; the approved shape is now 100% in the Lab.
